# HYP-2305 — The alternating group graph AG_n: 3-cycle (cube-root) generators, 3-chromatic, χ·α=|V| tight

**Session:** claudebox-2026-06-04-S635. **Prompt (user):** consider the alternating group graph and how it changes
as n varies, regarding the recent (HN/LRC/unit-distance) work. **Threads:** HYP-2300 (χ·α≥n bridge), HYP-2299
(colorings/Tutte), HYP-2265 (7=Φ₃(2)/cube root), HYP-2245 (3-cycles=H).

## AG_n: the Cayley graph of A_n generated by 3-cycles
`AG_n` = the alternating group graph = Cayley graph of `A_n` with the 3-cycles `(1 2 i), (1 i 2)` as generators
(`|V| = n!/2`, `2(n−2)`-regular, vertex-transitive, girth 3). Its generators are exactly the **3-cycles** — the
object the whole arc converges on: the 3-cycle = the tournament resonance (HYP-2245), the unit equilateral, the
chromatic obstruction (HYP-2299), and the **cube root of unity** (`σ³ = 1`, eigenvalues `1, ω, ω² = e^{±2πi/3}`,
the `π/3`/`Φ₃` of S628/HYP-2265).

## How AG_n changes with n (computed)
| n | \|V\|=n!/2 | reg=2(n−2) | girth | χ | α | χ·α |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 3 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 1 | 3 = \|V\| |
| 4 | 12 | 4 | 3 | 3 | 4 | 12 = \|V\| |
| 5 | 60 | 6 | 3 | 3 | 20 | 60 = \|V\| |
**AG_3 = K₃ = the triangle = the 3-cycle = the cube root of unity literally** (the resonance atom incarnate). And
across `n`: **AG_n is 3-chromatic** (the girth-3 triangle forces `χ ≥ 3`; a 3-coloring exists), with `α = |V|/3`, so
the **`χ·α = |V|` bound is TIGHT** (vertex-transitive ⟹ `χ_f = |V|/α = 3` exactly). So `AG_n` realizes the cube-root
`3` as its chromatic number for *every* `n` — "the third color" (HYP-2299) as a fixed chromatic value.

## The S634 bound is ground truth (a verification catch)
My first `α` computation gave `AG_4: α = 2` ⟹ `χ·α = 6 < 12`, contradicting the formalized `χ·α ≥ n`
(`exists_indepSet_card_mul_ge`, S634). The theorem CAUGHT the bug: `χ = 3` *forces* a color class of size `≥ 12/3 = 4`,
so `α ≥ 4` (corrected `α = 4`). The formalized bound is the ground truth that disciplines the computation.

## The unification (regarding the recent work)
`AG_n` is a **vertex-transitive Cayley graph** — the discrete analogue of the unit-distance graph of a homogeneous
space (HYP-2300). The three questions transfer: max edges / chromatic number / max independent set (the `χ·α=|V|`
bridge is tight here). Its generators (3-cycles = cube roots) are the resonance; its chromatic number is the cube-root
`3`; its independence sets are the "lonely" sets. So `AG_n` is a concrete, fully-computable model of the
HN/LRC/unit-distance trinity, with the cube-root resonance as the literal generating set.
